answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vault of the next round. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the violet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
